title: Power savings for intersective polynomial differences and prime arguments

result.label: Power savings for intersective polynomial differences and prime arguments
result.statement: For every fixed intersective integer polynomial h of degree k ≥ 2 with positive leading coefficient, proves that a subset of 1, ,N avoiding nonzero values h(1),h(2), as differences has size Oh(N^ 1-ck ), with ck 0 depending only on degree. Here intersective means having a root modulo every modulus. For prime arguments, a power saving also holds when h has a unit root modulo every modulus, with exponent allowed to depend on h .
